## ◌ Concept
> Is your feature request related to a problem or just a new spark of inspiration? Please describe. 

## ✦ The Solution
What would you like to see happen? A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you're proposing.

## ⚡ Why it matters?
How will this feature help the learners in the **Halqa** community? (e.g., "It will save time finding documentation").

## 🌑 Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any other ways to achieve this? (Optional)

## 📌 Visuals & Context
If you have any sketches, screenshots, or design ideas, drop them here.

**Thank you for helping us evolve the circle. 🪶**
